51609646.protein: V-type immunoglobulin domain-containing suppressor of T-cell activation
51609646.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human VISTA assessed as dissociation constant by SPR binding assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: SPR Binding Assay. SPR binding assay were performed on a Biacore S200 (General Electric Company, USA). Tested compounds were dissolved in DMSO at 1 mM concentration and diluted by PBS-P+ buffer (5% DMSO). The hVISTA protein was diluted to 100 μg/mL with sodium acetate solution (pH = 5.5), then the protein was conjugated to CMS chip. Tested compounds at different concentrations was injected at a flow rate of 0.5 μL/s at 25 °C. The Kd value was calculated using the Langmuir binding model.
